conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.summary: Can't see and automatically fails ability checks that need sight. Attack rolls against it have Advantage; its own attack rolls have Disadvantage.

flags.hint: Checks that rely on sight fail automatically (not merely Disadvantage).

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.summary: Can't attack the charmer or target it with damaging abilities or magical effects. The charmer has Advantage on checks to interact with it socially.

flags.hint: Warn when it attacks or aims a damaging effect at the charmer (the condition's source).

srd51.summary: 5.1: can't attack the charmer or target it with harmful (not only damaging) abilities or magical effects; the charmer has Advantage on social checks.

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.summary: Can't hear and automatically fails any ability check that requires hearing.

flags.hint: Checks that rely on hearing fail automatically.

conditions.name: Exhaustion
conditions.summary: Cumulative levels: D20 Tests are reduced by 2 × level and Speed by 5 ft × level; level 6 is death. Each Long Rest removes 1 level.

flags.hint: Stacks (the only condition that does). −2 × level to every D20 Test (checks, attacks, saves); −5 ft × level to Speed and every special speed (p. 188); level 6 = death; Long Rest −1 level.

srd51.summary: 5.1: six cumulative steps: 1 Dis. on checks; 2 Speed halved; 3 Dis. on attacks and saves; 4 HP max halved; 5 Speed 0; 6 death. Long Rest −1 with food.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.summary: Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of its fear is within line of sight. Can't willingly move closer to the source.

flags.hint: Disadvantage applies only while the source is in line of sight. Can't willingly move closer to the source (hint only).

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.summary: Speed 0. Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but the grappler, who can drag or carry it. Escape: an action and an Athletics or Acrobatics check.

flags.hint: Disadvantage only against targets other than the grappler. Grappler pays +1 ft per ft to move it unless it is Tiny or 2+ sizes smaller. Unarmed Strike escape DC = 8 + Str mod + PB (p. 190); stat blocks give their own DC.

srd51.summary: 5.1: Speed 0; ends if the grappler is Incapacitated or it's moved out of reach. No attack penalty; escape is a contested Athletics/Acrobatics check (p. 95).

conditions.name: Incapacitated
conditions.summary: Can't take actions, Bonus Actions or Reactions; its Concentration breaks; can't speak. Disadvantage on Initiative if Incapacitated when rolling it.

flags.hint: Can't speak, so no Verbal-component spells. Ends Dodge benefits. Speed is unaffected in 5.2.1.

srd51.summary: 5.1: can't take actions or reactions. No speech or Initiative clause; Concentration still ends when Incapacitated (5.1 p. 102).

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.summary: Advantage on Initiative. Unaffected by effects that need to see it; gear hidden too. Attacks vs it have Disadvantage and its attacks Advantage unless seen.

flags.hint: Attack modifiers don't apply against a creature that can somehow see it (Blindsight, Truesight, See Invisibility).

srd51.summary: 5.1: can't be seen without magic or a special sense; heavily obscured for hiding; noise or tracks reveal it. Same attack effects; no Initiative effect.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.summary: Incapacitated; Speed 0. Automatically fails Str and Dex saves. Attacks against it have Advantage, and hits from within 5 ft are Critical Hits.

flags.hint: Includes the Incapacitated condition (its concentration, speech and Initiative effects apply).

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.summary: Turned to stone (weight ×10, stops aging). Incapacitated; Speed 0; fails Str/Dex saves; attacks vs it have Advantage; Resistance to all damage.

flags.hint: Includes Incapacitated. Immune to the Poisoned condition. No automatic Critical Hits.

srd51.summary: 5.1: as 5.2.1, but also unaware of its surroundings and immune to poison and disease (any already in its system is suspended).

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.summary: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.summary: Can only crawl or spend half its Speed to stand (not at Speed 0). Its attacks have Disadvantage; attacks vs it: Advantage within 5 ft, else Disadvantage.

flags.hint: Crawling costs +1 ft per ft (+2 in Difficult Terrain); standing costs half Speed, rounded down. Dropping Prone is free unless Speed is 0 (p. 14).

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.summary: Speed 0. Attack rolls against it have Advantage and its attack rolls have Disadvantage. Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.summary: Incapacitated. Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against it have Advantage. It can still move in 5.2.1.

flags.hint: Includes Incapacitated. No Speed 0 in 5.2.1 (the 5.1 pack must treat it as Speed 0).

srd51.summary: 5.1: Incapacitated, can't move, speaks only falteringly; automatically fails Str and Dex saves; attack rolls against it have Advantage.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.summary: Incapacitated and Prone (stays Prone after); drops what it holds; Speed 0; unaware. Fails Str/Dex saves; attacks vs it have Advantage; hits within 5 ft crit.

flags.hint: Also Prone: beyond 5 ft, Prone's Disadvantage cancels this Advantage (a normal roll). noSight derives from 'unaware of its surroundings'.

markers.name: Bloodied
markers.summary: Has half its Hit Points or fewer. No effect on its own, but other rules and effects can key off it (p. 16). Not in SRD 5.1.

markers.name: Concentrating
markers.summary: Ends on starting another Concentration effect, on Incapacitated, or on death. Damage forces a Con save: DC 10 or half the damage if higher, max 30.

markers.name: Death saves
markers.summary: At 0 HP, roll d20 at turn start: 10+ succeeds. 3 successes: Stable; 3 failures: dies. Nat 1 = 2 failures, nat 20 = 1 HP. Damage = 1 failure (crit 2).

markers.name: Stable
markers.summary: At 0 HP but makes no Death Saving Throws; still Unconscious. Taking damage restarts death saves. If not healed, regains 1 HP after 1d4 hours.

markers.name: Dead
markers.summary: Has no Hit Points and can be revived only by magic. On revival it keeps ongoing effects, has 1 fewer Exhaustion level and loses all Attunements.

markers.name: Hidden
markers.summary: Succeeded on a DC 15 Stealth Hide: Invisible while hidden; its total is the DC to find it. Ends on noise, being found, an attack roll or a Verbal spell.

markers.name: Surprised
markers.summary: Caught unaware as combat starts: Disadvantage on its Initiative roll (p. 13). In 5.1 it instead can't move or act on its first turn (5.1 p. 90).

markers.name: Dodging
markers.summary: Dodge: until its next turn, attacks vs it have Disadvantage if it sees the attacker; Advantage on Dex saves. Lost if Incapacitated or its Speed is 0.

markers.name: Disengaged
markers.summary: Disengage action: its movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks for the rest of the current turn.

markers.name: Dashing
markers.summary: Dash action: extra movement this turn equal to its Speed after modifiers; it may use a special speed (such as Fly) instead.

markers.name: Heroic Inspiration
markers.summary: A player character can expend it to reroll any die just rolled and must use the new roll. Only one is held; an extra is lost unless given to another PC.

markers.name: Blessed
markers.summary: Bless (Concentration, up to 1 minute): adds 1d4 to each attack roll and saving throw it makes until the spell ends.

markers.name: Baned
markers.summary: Bane (Concentration, up to 1 minute): after a failed Cha save, it subtracts 1d4 from each attack roll and saving throw until the spell ends.

markers.name: Hasted
markers.summary: Haste: Speed doubled, +2 AC, Adv. on Dex saves, one extra limited action a turn. When it ends: Incapacitated and Speed 0 until the end of its next turn.

markers.name: Slowed
markers.summary: Slow: Speed halved, −2 AC and Dex saves, no Reactions, an action or Bonus Action (not both), 1 attack; 25% Somatic spell failure; Wis save each turn.

markers.name: Burning
markers.summary: Burning hazard: 1d4 Fire damage at the start of each of its turns. An action spent going Prone and rolling puts it out, as does dousing or submerging.

markers.name: Flying
markers.summary: Falls if Incapacitated, Prone or its Fly Speed drops to 0, unless it can hover. A fall deals 1d6 Bludgeoning per 10 ft (max 20d6) and leaves it Prone.

markers.name: Readied
markers.summary: Ready action: on a chosen trigger, it uses its Reaction to act or move up to its Speed. A readied spell is cast now and held with Concentration (p. 187).

markers.name: Custom marker
markers.summary: App status only: a DM-defined marker (name, glyph, description, optional duration in rounds). It stands for no SRD rule.
